pages.name: Logos
pages.title: One spark. Four arrangements.
pages.subtitle: Keep the original artwork intact. Choose an arrangement for the space.

elements.text: Use original letter outlines. Never retype the logo. Horizontal and stacked placements are kit extensions, not new source masters.

pages.name: Space and size
pages.title: Give the spark room.
pages.subtitle: Recommended production rules for this kit.

elements.text: Keep at least one arrowhead-width clear around the complete logo. Keep artwork proportional and separate it from text and image edges.
CHECK A PRINTED PROOF / AVOID THE FULL LOGO AT FAVICON SIZE

pages.name: Colour
pages.title: Orange ignites. Navy anchors.
pages.subtitle: Colours sampled directly from the website theme.

elements.text: Use navy or slate for body text on cream. Use cream or white on navy. Orange is an accent: orange on cream and white on orange do not meet normal-text contrast.

pages.name: Typography
pages.title: A practical voice, a human touch.
pages.subtitle: Outfit for headings and interface. Source Serif 4 for reading.

elements.text: SparkLab is UNBC’s product creation lab — a space where students, researchers, and community members transform concepts into tangible prototypes.
The logo’s lettering is supplied artwork; neither of these typefaces replaces it.

pages.name: Supporting graphics
pages.title: A field for ideas.
pages.subtitle: The arrow and spark provide direction, repetition and scale.

elements.text: Crop supporting graphics freely. Keep the identifying logo complete. Use the service icons as navigation aids; never replace the logo with an icon.

pages.name: Stationery
pages.title: From a first conversation.
pages.subtitle: Cards, letters and email signatures with editable fields.

pages.name: Projects and workshops
pages.title: Make the work visible.
pages.subtitle: Posters, social posts, project briefs and presentations.

elements.text: Replace bracketed fields with verified event details. Confirm hours and locations before printing.

pages.name: Motion
pages.title: An idea comes into focus.
pages.subtitle: Logo, loading and interface studies derived from the arrow and spark.

elements.text: Reveal the original parts, then rest. Loading studies may loop only while work is in progress. Interface transitions follow the website’s ease-out-expo curve.
Quick 180 ms · base 400 ms · slow 700 ms. Respect reduced-motion preferences: show the final frame immediately. Keep interactive focus visible.

pages.name: Production and sources
pages.title: Ready to build on.
pages.subtitle: Original source artwork, local open fonts and a reproducible definition.

elements.text: SVG for scalable artwork. PNG for slides and everyday documents. PDF for proofs. Word and PowerPoint exports keep text editable. The kit includes an email signature, tokens, a React logo component, a website preview and a motion library.

Original logo: sparklab.unbc.ca/wp-content/uploads/logo.svg. Palette, typography, service names and public contact details: sparklab.unbc.ca and its theme stylesheet. Source files and hashes accompany the kit.

Application layouts, alternate logo arrangements, recommended sizes and motion studies were developed for this kit. They are not presented as an approved UNBC identity manual. Do not stretch, rotate, add effects to, or retype the identifying artwork.
ORIGINAL OUTLINES / POSITIVE, REVERSE AND MONOCHROME COLOURWAYS

rules.title: An idea becomes a whole.
rules.text: Reveal the arrow, spark and original lettering, then hold the complete logo.

rules.title: Use the website’s easing.
rules.text: Ease-out-expo settles entrances; short, direct transitions acknowledge interaction.

rules.title: Loop only while waiting.
rules.text: Loading indicators stop when the task finishes. Do not loop the identifying logo in a page header.

rules.title: Respect reduced motion.
rules.text: Show a clear final frame immediately when reduced motion is requested. Preserve all information and controls.
